about.title: About me
about.subtitle: I'm a freelance web developer with over 5 years of experience helping small businesses, brands, and companies across different industries get more clients. I've worked independently with clients of all sizes, both in Argentina and in other countries across Latin America and the United States, which taught me to understand what each business needs before writing a single line of code.
about.subtitleRest: I'm self-taught — I'm constantly learning to use current tools, which results in websites that are faster, more modern, and easier to maintain. I don't work at an agency or with a large team. When you hire me, you talk directly with me.

faq.subtitle: These are the questions clients ask me most before starting a project.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions about

faqs.preg: How long does it take to build the website?
faqs.res: It depends on the project. A landing page can be ready in 1 to 2 weeks. An e-commerce site or more complex project can take 3 to 5 weeks. I always give you a clear timeline before starting.

faqs.preg: How much does a website cost?
faqs.res: Every project is different, so I don't have fixed prices. But I can give you a free quote after a quick chat. Message me and we'll go over it.

faqs.preg: Do I need to know about technology to work with you?
faqs.res: Not at all. I explain things in simple terms and guide you through every step. You focus on your business, I take care of the rest.

faqs.preg: Can I update the website myself afterward?
faqs.res: Yes. Depending on the type of project, I'll deliver the site with a simple panel so you can make basic changes without relying on anyone.

faqs.preg: What happens if I need changes after it's published?
faqs.res: Minor adjustments during the delivery period are free. For changes afterward, we can set up a monthly maintenance plan or handle it on a case-by-case basis.

faqs.preg: Do you work with clients from any industry?
faqs.res: Yes. I've worked with restaurants, stores, cosmetics brands, real estate agencies, and more. If you have a business and need an online presence, I can help.

why.title: What you get when we work together
why.subtitle: Every project is built to help your business build trust, attract more clients, and have a professional online presence.

razones.title: Built to get you messages
razones.des: Every button, every line of text is there to get the visitor to take the next step: message you, ask for a quote, or buy. It's not just about showing who you are, it's about getting people to reach out.

razones.title: Every site is built around your business
razones.des: Before designing anything, we talk about how your business works, who your customers are, and what you want to achieve. The site is built from that, not the other way around.

razones.title: Make a great impression from the first second
razones.des: A thoughtful design and a clear structure let any visitor understand in seconds who you are, what you offer, and why they should choose you over the competition.

razones.title: You focus on your business, I focus on the tech
razones.des: I handle the design, development, and launch without you needing to know any code. If you need to make simple changes later, I'll leave you an easy-to-use panel; for everything else, I'm just a message away.

razones.title: You always talk to me, not a support ticket
razones.des: No middlemen, no support teams. If a question comes up along the way or something isn't turning out as expected, you message me directly and we figure it out together.

casos.title: How I help businesses grow their digital presence
casos.subtitle: Every project starts with a real goal: improving how a company presents itself, attracts clients, and scales its business online.

casos.title: HomeSilva
casos.objetivo: Digitize the property portfolio and generate more inquiries from potential clients.
casos.solucion: I designed and developed a real estate platform with individual property listings, search filters, interactive maps, optimized landing pages, and direct contact forms. I also built an admin panel so the agency can upload and manage its properties independently.
casos.resultado: The agency now has its own platform to manage and showcase its property portfolio, improve the search experience, and increase inquiries without relying on third parties.

casos.title: PS Flooring
casos.objetivo: Strengthen the business's digital presence, showcase installation services, prepare for material sales, and expand into new services like epoxy.
casos.solucion: I developed a bilingual (English/Spanish) platform with a service and product catalog, login system, shopping cart, checkout, contact forms, custom quotes, and an estimate calculator for clients. I also included sections for completed projects and featured work to build trust.
casos.resultado: The company now has a platform ready to attract new clients, sell materials online, and evolve its business model from services toward a hybrid offering of installation and product sales.

footer.title: I help businesses and small companies improve their digital presence with fast, conversion-focused websites.
